w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
firstContext: Ivan SCREAMS — a sound like milk curdling in fast-forward. The The Big-Eyes freezes. (stunned)
🐗 This one came with the raid on Haven — it was with the teeth at the door, not a lone wanderer.
📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
🌿 Gilberto returns from foraging the wilds: +267 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 266 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
👥 Ananya heads out to forage. "There's food out there. Going to find it." The pantry won't fill itself.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: "Stonebridge is eating bark and calling it dinner," Grace says. "We left before we started looking at each other like food."
They're named, every one: Grace Larsen, Felix Fischer, Ruth Weber. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1000 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/10/6), with 4 wave-4 fought, 15 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 19 · Craft 9 · Talk 23 · Explore 44 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ivan Villa ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,022 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
